Commentary.Commentary: No AB de Villiers, no party, it seems, because South Africa haven't got a big score on the board like they usually do in a Pink ODI. Though, there is one thing to remember - their previous lowest total against Pakistan at home was 182, and they managed to win that game by 62 runs. Some bounce and turn available on this surface, so it might not be all over. We'll find out what happens in the second half.

A clinical performance from Pakistan with the ball. Except for that Amla-Faf century stand, there really wasn't anything of note for the Saffas. The decision to bowl first has been justified. Afridi once again started well with the new ball by dismissing de Kock and Reeza Hendricks early. There was some resistance in the middle, when Amla and du Plessis scored their respective fifties, but even then the runs were clogged up by the spinners and the pressure eventually got to them. Post that, Usman Khan ran riot by picking 4 wickets in his 6 balls and that saw the hosts end with their lowest first innings total against Pakistan at home.

OUT! Yes, Shadab does the clean up. Gives this air outside off, tempts Tahir to go over the top. Tahir gets low and slogs but cannot get it far enough. Imad Wasim at long on takes a simple catch. SOUTH AFRICA ARE ALL OUT FOR 164 IN 41 OVERS.
Leg spinner outside off, cut to backward point.
Outside off, Hendricks punches it towards the off side and rotates strike.
Loopy ball on middle, Tahir swings and lofts it towards long on for another run.
Turn and bounce, Tahir looks to cut it but gets beaten. The keeper takes it at a good height.
Full on middle, Hendricks plays it to long on for one.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled by the umpire. Five fielders can now stay outside the circle. Also, Shadab Khan is back to take the last wicket.
Full delivery attacking the stumps, pushed off the front foot to the cover region. End of another good over from Usman Khan.
No wide signalled. Interesting. Usman brings out the short ball and takes Tahir by surprise. He ducks under it as it's angling down.
Fuller length ball, curving in from outside off, Tahir meets the ball with the full face of the bat.

FOUR! Streaky runs! Masterful from Imran Tahir. Usman fires the yorker in on off, Tahir gets low, brings his bat down and gets an inside edge which goes past leg stump. It races down to fine leg for a boundary.
Good length delivery outside off, pushed away from the body by Tahir to point.
Imran Tahir is the last batsman in for South Africa.

OUT! Edged and taken! Fourth of the innings for Usman Khan, all have come in his last 6 deliveries itself. He gets the last glimmer of hope which was left for South Africa. He's really turned the game on its head for Pakistan. Bowls a length ball well outside off, some slight movement away as Phehlukwayo gives the charge. Throws his bat at it but can only get an edge behind. Babar Azam at first slip takes a simple catch.
Driven towards the mid on region by BH.
Around off, blocked by Beuran.
Closer to the stumps, Hendricks gets behind the ball and blocks it.
Full on middle, Hendricks plays it through mid-wicket.
Outside off, Hendricks shoulders his arms to this.
On a good length on middle and leg, Andile turns his bat to the on side and gets one.

ALMOST! ALMOST! Usman Khan nearly gets a hat-trick and also his fourth of the over. Fires this full angling into Hendricks on the leg stump. Beuran misses his flick and the ball hits him on his legs. Everyone puts in an appeal but the umpire shakes his head. No reviews left for either team. It wouldn't have mattered. Replays show us that there was a slight inside edge before the ball hit his pads. That is the only thing that would have saved him. An eventful over comes to an end. 3 wickets and just one run from it.
Beuran Hendricks to face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! What is happening? Third wicket of the over and Usman Khan is on a hat-trick. Serves this on a good length outside off, Rabada looks to leave it but then is too late in doing so. Gets a feather behind to Rizwan while getting his bat down and Pakistan appeal. The umpire gets his finger up and Rabada knows what he has done.
Kagiso Rabada will be the new man in.

OUT! Bowled 'em! What a cracker! Steyn has no answer for it. Bull's eye and Pakistan are on a roll. Comes running in from round the wicket and darts in a yorker on middle. Steyn gives room and looks to get bat on it but fails to get any. The furniture is disturbed and South Africa lose their 7th wicket.
Full on middle, Steyn hits it back to the bowler.
Dale Steyn walks out next to bat.

OUT! Rassie departs. Good pace and bounce on that and Usman gets his man. This is the first time in this series van der Dussen has been dismissed. Back of a length ball outside off, van der Dussen looks to run it down but gets an outside edge back to the keeper. Rizwan takes a simple catch and Usman is up in celebration. Just the 16 runs added by these two today, they cannot provide heroics of the 2nd game.
Andile plays the Square-Cut. They pick up a single.
Usman Khan is back into the attack.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Takes the pace off this one. The ball holds its line. On middle and leg, Rassie almost gives a return catch to Amir.
Back of a length on off, Rassie is happy to block it. 4 dots in a row.
No room to work with, Rassie gives another ball to the fielder at point.
On that fourth stump line, Rassie taps it to the point region.
Good line around off, Rassie taps it to the off side.
Full outside off, Andile drives it superbly but straight to the man at covers.
On middle and leg, Phehlukwayo misses his flick and gets hit high on the pads.
Gets behind this one and defends this near the pitch.
Full on off, Andile drives it to mid off.

Inside edge and he almost chops it on. Length ball around off, Andile yet again gets an inside edge which goes over the stumps. Here's a thing, when he is middling it, the ball is traveling. Quite a few inside and bottom edges already for him.
Rassie plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
Back of a length on off, Andile taps the ball in front of him. 9 runs off the over.
Outside off, Andile tries to cut but another bottom edge for him.
FOUR! Second of the over. Length ball outside off, Phehlukwayo stands tall and punches this through covers. It makes a lovely sound and the ball races away to the ropes.
In line of the stumps, Phehlukwayo defends it from within his crease.
Played to the mid-wicket region by van der Dussen. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Good start to the over for Rassie. Outside off, width on offer, Rassie extends his arms and lofts this over point for a boundary. Third man was too fine to cut that out.
Outside off, cut to the man at cover-point.
Not far away from the off stump. Andile tries to cut it but gets another bottom edge near the stumps.
FOUR! Nice! Just a gentle push and the ball travels to the fence. Slightly back of a length on off, Andile punches the ball through covers, beats the in-field and gets a boundary for it.
Fuller outside off, Phehlukwayo tries to put bat to ball but fails.
Length again outside off, Andile leaves it alone.
Length ball over the stumps, Andile puts bat to that but gets a bottom edge to it which goes over the woodwork.
Rassie has pushed it to the cover region.
Yorker! Lovely from Andile. Darts this full in line of the stumps. Andile does well to put his bat down. The ball goes towards the on side and they cross.
Fuller on middle, kept out by AP.
On middle and leg, Andile plays it towards mid-wicket.
Andile Phehlukwayo is the new man in.

OUT! Amir gets his man and the change in bowling does the trick. Comes in from over the wicket and lands this on off. It angles into Miller who misses his flick and gets rapped in front. They put in an appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Miller has a chat and then takes it up. After a couple of replays Hawk Eye shows us that the ball would have gone to hit the leg stump. South Africa lose their review and David has to walk back. His bad form in ODIs against Pakistan continues. Today was a good chance for him to better that record.
LBW review! Amir has caught Miller in front of the stumps, the umpire has given it out. Miller reviews. Going down leg?
On a good length around off, Rassie taps it to the off side for one.

Drinks are on the field. Pakistan on top as things stand. Shadab and Wasim kept piling the pressure from both ends and eventually got rid of du Plessis and Amla. Two new batsmen at the crease now, crucial period for both sides. Also, Mohammad Amir comes back into the attack as well.
Shapes in late off the seam, a length ball around off, Miller plays away from his body and gets an inside edge down towards fine leg. Two runs are taken.
Miller walks down the track to this length ball and pushes it to the right of the bowler.
Short of a good length outside off, patted down in front of backward point.
Spills it on the hips, it's nudged to backward square leg as the batsmen pinch a quick one.
Wants two and gets two as well. Good running between the wickets. Van der Dussen wrists this away through square leg and comes back for the second.
Good length delivery rising off the deck, kept out from the back foot.
Shaheen Afridi is called back on.
Turning in from outside off, landing on a driving length, Miller blocks. That brings an end to a wonderful spell from Imad Wasim. He finishes with figures of 10-0-36-1.
Tossed up delivery outside off, eased away down the ground, to the long off fielder, for a single.
Flatter delivery around off, turning in, Miller goes on the back foot and punches it through mid on for one.
Drifting in on a full length on leg, van der Dussen flicks it comfortably to the vacant square leg area and crosses over.
Over the wicket to Miller, who instantly gets off the mark with a drive through to sweeper cover. Single taken.
David Miller strides out amid a big ovation from the crowd.

OUT! Bowled 'em! The set batsman, the big fish, has been dismissed. Malik persisted with Imad, put him in to bowl out and he's delivered. A quicker delivery on off, it goes on straight as Amla looks to play across the line with zero foot movement. The ball goes under his bat and takes the off stump with it. South Africa in some trouble now.
The flipper on middle and leg, worked away on the leg side with gentle hands.
In the air but Amla is safe. Looks to go big downtown to this tossed up leg break outside off, but his bat spins in his hand and the ball spoons over covers. A single is collected.
Quicker, shorter and outside off, cut a bit square through cover-point. Another run to the total.
A little too full, the ball can't turn, Amla uses his wrists to work this down to long on to rotate strike.
Easily done. Just comes forward and pushes it to long off for a run.
Drifting in on middle and then turning, the leg break, Rassie sticks back and cuts it to backward point.
Rassie van der Dussen rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total
Landed short with some room on offer outside off, Amla cuts it through the covers and jogs across to the other end.
Short and wide outside off, cut away square on the off side but not in the gap.
In the air for a short while but it falls safely. Amla uppishly punches it to the left of the bowler.
Full and straight from Wasim, Amla plays it back to the bowler.
Quicker in pace, punched through to sweeper cover for a run.
Leans ahead to this tossed up delivery and drives it through mid off for a single.

Missed out there! Spinning away from a shorter length, room on offer, was there to be hit, but Rassie van der Dussen can't connect. Good captaincy though from Malik as well. He kept silly point in place and left a gap in the covers, for the batsman to play that exact shot. Almost got the edge. Nicely done.
Quicker through the air once more, the leg break around off, van der Dussen pushes it to covers.
Some decent pace on this, full and turning away on off, the batsman prods forward in defense.
Served short on off and it turns away, Rassie mistimes the punch to the left of the bowler.
Sticks on the back foot and offers a firm punch to sweeper cover. The batsmen cross over.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Spins away, fullish in length, Amla looks to defend with a slightly closed face but it goes off the leading edge towards cover-point.
Cramps the batsman for room, all he can do is defend it back down the track.
Rassie van der Dussen is off the mark. He punches it through the gap in the off side and gets to the other end.
Shorter in length once more, just outside off, blocked.
Quicker through the air, around off, van der Dussen keeps it out from inside the crease.
Rassie van der Dussen walks out to the middle next.

OUT! Shadab gets the last laugh. A little bit of bounce and this time Faf isn't in control at all. He gets down once more, looks to sweep it away but it goes off the top edge this time. Balloons towards Hafeez at deep mid-wicket who takes it moving to his right. Big wicket for Pakistan, they needed this and it's come at the right time. Partnership of 101 comes to a close.

FOUR! So much control as he plays that. Well executed, right in the gap. The 100-run stand between these two comes up as well. Tossed up outside off, du Plessis gets low, rolls his wrists on this as he drags the sweep through square leg for a boundary.
Drags the length short, keeps it outside off, slapped through to sweeper cover. A single is collected.
Well played. Not a lot of pace on it so it won't go all the way to the fence, but it's enough to fetch him three good runs. Faf gets forward and across before paddling it fine down the leg side.

FOUR! 30th ODI fifty for Faf du Plessis, what a way to bring it up. He's been trying to nail that shot for a while now, finally gets it right. Tossed up on the stumps, he kneels down and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full delivery on off stump, pushed to the left of the bowler who stops it well.
Shorter ball turning away, around off, Amla cuts it square but straight to point.
Once again Faf makes room and slaps it aerially past the diving extra cover fielder, down to long off for one run.
Nice shape on this as it drifts in and then spins away, on off, du Plessis drives it to mid off.
A slight halt in play. Seems as if one of the LED bails has run out of battery. A replacement has been called for. Faf du Plessis uses this time to have a change of bats.
Loopy leg break around off, driven firmly to the covers. He wanted the run but then decided to abort.
Makes room but can't put it away. Imad follows him, Faf kneels down to unfurl the big slog sweep but it goes past the inside edge.
Short and outside off, punched off the back foot through the covers for a single.
Defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Strides forward and pushes it with the spin to cover-point. Looks for a run but eventually decides against it.
Full and flighted on middle, du Plessis is on the front foot in defense.
Driven towards the mid off region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Arm ball on off, staying low a bit, Faf adjusts well and punches it through covers for a run.
Short and wide outside off, Amla stands tall and slaps it to sweeper cover for a run.
Spinning away from around off, du Plessis guards it out from the back foot.

Fifty for Hashim Amla! His 37th in ODI cricket. What a champion. The veteran has still got it. He leans into the full ball and drives it through mid on for one. He's done the rebuilding job well, has to score a big one today.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Safe! The South African skipper survives. Faf taps it to cover-point and takes off. Shadab from point moves to his right and scores a direct hit at the bowler's end. It's taken upstairs but replays show du Plessis is fine. Single completed.
A run out appeal against Faf du Plessis. Looks to be safe, at least from the body language of the visitors.
Stays back and keeps it out off the back foot.

Chance of a run out! Amla works it down on the leg side and takes off. Rizwan gets to the ball himself, turns and fires it to Imad at his end. He can't collect cleanly, so Hashim is able to make it in.
That wasn't far off from the off stump. Some extra bounce for Shadab once more. Around off, the leg break, Faf looks to sweep but is beaten.
Works it to mid-wicket for no run.

Some sharp turn and bounce for Shadab. Almost takes du Plessis by surprise. It's landed on off and it turns away with some extra bounce. Faf plays at it initially but then withdraws from the shot at the last second.
Goes with the spin, uses soft hands to tap it down on the off side.
Spinning away from around off, du Plessis pushes it square towards point with an open face.
Uses the depth of the crease to go back, it's short and flat on the stumps, Hashim wrists it in front of square leg for one run.
Seeing the ball land short, Amla camps back and slaps it through covers for a single.
Slower through the air, full on middle and leg, defended by bringing his bat ahead of his pad.
Fraction straight in line, some drift inwards again, Hashim Amla flicks it straight to the mid-wicket fielder.
Short, around off and turning away, Amla opens the face of the bat and punches it to point.
Goes with the spin and finds the gap through the covers. One run to the total.
Drifting in on middle and off, pushed to mid off from the front foot.
The skipper goes down the ground too, but to the other side. Finds wide long on and keeps strike with a run.
Comes forward to this fuller length ball and eases it down to long off. Gets to the other end with ease.
Floats it up again, on off stump, Faf gets low and brings out the slog sweep. Manages to get it off the inner half through square leg for one.
Tossed right up there, Amla defends it from the outer half towards point for a single.
On leg stump line, Faf comes down the track and drives it to long off for a run.
Loopy full ball on middle, Faf is on the front foot in defense.
Fullish and on off, Amla drives but finds the cover fielder.
Quicker and on off, Amla stays back and pushes it out with an angled bat to short third man.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Short and wide outside off, Amla reaches out for it and slaps it through point for a crunching boundary.
Floated full ball on off, Amla leans forward and flicks it straight to mid-wicket.
Flatter and on middle, du Plessis moves back and turns it to square leg for a speedy single.
Walks forward to a full ball and pushes it with the spin to covers.
Beaten! Lovely leg spinner, turning away with bounce from around off, Amla pushes inside the line and misses.
Appeal for an lbw! Floated and around leg, du Plessis tries to sweep but misses. They appeal but nothing from the umpire. They take a leg bye. Maybe, it pitched outside leg.
Beauty! Shadab lands this one around leg and gets it to spin towards off, Faf tries to defend but misses and it beats the outside edge.
Quicker one on off, pushed out in the direction of point.
SIX! That's a fantastic shot! A full ball around off, spinning away a touch, du Plessis walks forward and lofts it nonchalantly over extra cover.
Quicker and fuller on off, defended back to the bowler.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Faf gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Short and outside off, cut to point.
Outside off, tapped down to point.
Flatter and on off, blocked from the back foot.
Flatter on off, defended back.

Didn't get any hand on it! Full and on middle, Faf pushes it right back and Shadab tries to stop it by going down low. Fails to get any hand on it and the ball goes on to break the stumps at the other end. The way the leggie is looking disappointed, maybe, Amla might have been outside the crease.
Gets on the front foot and drives it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Tossed up ball on middle, fuller in length, du Plessis sits down on one knee and nails his sweep shot behind square leg for a boundary.
Reaches out for a delivery wide outside off and strokes his drive to sweeper cover for one.
Full flighted on off, du Plessis plays an on drive and a run is taken.
Shadab Khan to bowl his leggies now.
FOUR! Well played! Imad hurls in a short and wide delivery outside off, Amla rocks back and slaps it through the gap at backward point for a boundary. 50-run stand comes up!
Flighted and outside off, hit firmly through covers for one.
Played to the point region by the batsman. No run.
Quicker and flatter on middle, pushed out to covers and Amla wanted a run. He was sent back as the fielder attacked the ball but didn't release the throw.
Driven towards the mid on region. They pick up a single.
Flatter and on off, punched off the back foot and the extra cover fielder moved quickly to his right to make the stop.

Drinks break. Good going from South Africa after a quiet beginning. They lost Quinton de Kock and Reeza Hendricks cheaply but since then the experienced Hashim Amla and Faf du Plessis have settled in. Pakistan will need to bowl well in the middle overs.
A touch short again, around off, Faf taps it down to point and straightaway shouts 'NO'. 11 from the over.
A touch short and outside off, Amla quietly plays it down to third man and takes another run.
Good stop in the deep! Short and on middle, Faf pulls it firmly to deep mid-wicket where Hafeez scoots across to his left and makes a sliding stop. Saves one for his side.

Run out chance missed! It's all happening now! Good length ball around off, du Plessis dabs it down in front of Shadab at point and scampers to the other end. The fielder misses his shy at the striker's end otherwise Amla would have been a goner. No one backs the throw and they take an overthrow now.
A length ball outside off, Hashim pushes it to covers and rushes across as the fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end.
FOUR! Amla has settled in now! Back of a length delivery angling in from around off, Amla goes on his toes and pulls it behind square leg for a boundary. Runs have started to come post Powerplay 1.
Loopy and on middle, fuller in length, du Plessis flicks it off his pads to mid-wicket.
Gets forward to a full ball and strokes it to sweeper cover for one.
FOUR! That's a fine shot! Brings up the 50 for South Africa. Flighted and full around off, Amla makes some room and drills his drive through extra cover.
Flatter and on off, Amla pushes it out on the off side but not in the gap this time.
Gets forward and pushes it softly to covers for one more single.
Flighted and full on off, Amla drives it with the spin through covers for a run.
Imad Wasim is on.
Sharp delivery, another bouncer, this time on middle and leg, du Plessis tries to hook but misses.
Bouncer! The batsman does well to evade it.
Advances down the track to a length ball and cracks it through wide mid off for a couple.
Digs in a short ball on middle, Amla gets on top of the bounce and pulls it down to fine leg for a run.
Shortish and just outside off, too close to cut but Amla still goes for it and gets a bottom edge. It rolls to the keeper.
Angles in a shortish ball on off, from 'round the wicket, du Plessis shuffles across and turns it in the gap at mid-wicket for one.
Usman Khan is back on.
Good length ball on middle, du Plessis helps it in the gap at mid-wicket for a run. 11 from the over.
FOUR! A more conventional shot this time by the Protea skipper. Uses his lovely hands and plays a fluent cover drive to a full ball for a boundary.
FOUR! Shot! A touch short and on middle, du Plessis dances down the track, gives himself room and spanks it through extra cover. South Africa would hope this will break the shackles.
Shortish and outside off, Amla goes on his toes and guides it to third man for a run.
AERIAL! Amir senses the charge from the batsman and digs in a short ball. Du Plessis plays a reactive pull and it flies off the top edge to fine leg. Drops safely and they take a run.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Powerplay 2 time! A maximum of 4 fielders allowed outside the ring till the 40th over now.
Eases it off his pads in front of square leg for a run.
Back of a length ball on off, Amla pushes inside the line and edges it past gully for a run.

Dropped by Shadab but it was a tough one! Full and outside off, du Plessis plays an uppish square drive and it travels to point. Shadab flies to his left and attempts to catch it with his right hand but fails to hold on. Should have gone with both hands. The Protea skipper gets a life and a single.
Delicate glance by the batsman through the fine leg region. One run added to the total.
Shortish and outside off, Amla tries running it down to third man but Babar at gully dives to stop the ball.

Chance of a run out! Too full in length outside off, du Plessis drives it firmly to the left of the mid off fielder and scampers across to the other end. Malik has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses as Faf dives in. Would have been close.
Just turns a length ball off his pads to square leg and retains strike.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
A length ball around off, du Plessis defends it to the off side.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
With an extra slip in place, Amir hurls a length ball on off. Faf defends it solidly from the back foot.
Beaten! Movement away from the right-hander, du Plessis pushes inside the line and misses.
Du Plessis opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.

DAYLIGHT! Waste of a review. A delivery down the leg side, du Plessis tries to flick but fails to middle his shot. Is there an inside edge? Because the keeper is appealing for a catch. The bowler is also looking interested. The camera pans on the umpire, he is just found shaking his head and not signalling a wide. Malik waits a bit and then takes the review after getting the nod from his bowler. The replays roll in and they find nothing on the Ultra Edge. After the verdict from the third umpire, it's signalled a wide also. Pakistan lose their only review.
Appeal for a catch down the leg side! Nothing from the umpire and he has not signalled a wide either so far. Shoaib Malik asks his bowler and then takes the DRS.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Faf du Plessis shoulders arms.
Amla drives it straight back to the bowler who fails to stop it in his followthrough. Deflects it behind to mid on and they cross.
Shortish on middle, turned in the gap at square leg for one. Faf is off the mark.
Pitches it up and on middle, du Plessis pushes it down to mid on.

There is something in the surface. Shaheen serves a full ball around leg and gets it to straighten just a bit. Amla tries flicking but it takes the leading edge and hurries wide of point to third man. They pick up a single.
Wide! Not always you will get wickets off poor ones. Shaheen serves a length ball down the leg side, Amla tries flicking but misses. A good take by Rizwan.
Slants a length ball across the batsman, Hashim taps it down with an angled bat to backward point. The fielder fumbles slightly and they cross for a run.
Lands it on a length around off, Amla defends it watchfully to the off side.
Huge shout for an lbw! The umpire remains unmoved. A delivery around leg, Amla fails to work it around and is hit on the pads. Pitching outside leg. Amir is getting some shape going.
A length ball on leg, Amla brings down a straight bat and pushes it to the bowler.
On middle and off, defended off the back foot.

Oohhh... Amla nearly chips a simple catch to mid-wicket. Amir serves it on middle, gets a bit of inward shape, Hashim shuffles across and plays early at it. It lobs in the air but doesn't carry to the fielder.
Wide first up! Down the leg side, Amla tries flicking but misses.
Change in bowling. Mohammad Amir into the attack.
Good length ball on off, du Plessis defends it solidly to end the over, a wicket maiden.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Beauty to beat the bat! A back of a length delivery landing around leg and nipping away after landing. Faf is squared up there as it whizzes past the outside part of his bat. The bowler appeals but the keeper isn't interested much. Shoaib Malik doesn't get convinced to use the DRS. Nothing on the replays. A good decision by the umpire.
Close to off stump this time, just a fractionally shorter one, du Plessis once again lets it go after guarding his stumps.
Angling across a length delivery outside off, du Plessis covers his stumps and leaves it alone.
Skipper Faf du Plessis is in next with his team in a spot of bother.

OUT! Strangled down the leg side! A fine catch by Rizwan as well. Shaheen delivers a back of a length delivery down the leg side, it does something off the seam, Hendricks gets a bit across to flick but it takes a faint inside edge and travels behind. Rizwan dives across to his left to grab the catch. One more blow to South Africa. Pakistan are doing very well here, not leaking runs and picking wickets too.
Hurls in a good length delivery outside off, Amla allows it through. Pakistan keeping it tight.

Good length ball around off, straightening a bit, Reeza presents a straight bat to it but it takes the outside half of it and speeds past the diving point fielder for a run. Hendricks was eyeing the second run too but it was never on.
Wide! A length delivery too wide outside off, an easy leave by the batsman.
Back of a length ball around off, Reeza gets across and turns it in front of square leg. Walks outside the crease for a run but seeing the diving effort by Imam, he returns.
In the channel outside off, Hendricks watches it go to the keeper.
Identical to the last delivery, this time Reeza plays it with soft hands to mid-wicket.
Khan runs in from 'round the wicket and angles in a length ball on off, Hendricks defends it from the back foot.
On middle and leg, Amla flicks but finds the mid-wicket fielder. Just a run from the over.
This one is wide outside off, there is an invitation to go after it but Amla decides to let it go.
Lands it on a length around middle at 138 kph, Amla gets across a bit and defends it down safely.
Inside edge! Fullish and outside off, Hendricks is on the front foot to drive it through covers but it takes the inner portion of his bat and rolls in front of square leg for a run.
A length ball on off, Reeza plays it from the crease to the off side.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Three boundaries in the over. Once again there is width on offer outside off and Hashim just opens the face of his bat to fluently drive it through cover-point.
FOUR! Quality shot! It's on a length around off, Amla presses forward and caresses it with beautiful timing through extra cover for a boundary. So good to the eyes.
Width on offer outside off, Amla forces it through the line but finds the cover fielder.
On middle, helped on the leg side but straight to mid-wicket.
Good length ball on off, defended from the inside half of his bat.
FOUR! Too full and wide outside off, Amla reaches out for it and drills it through the gap at point. Fakhar gives the chase and tries to pull it back with a full length dive but fails.
Reeza Hendricks is the new batsman.

OUT! It's clipping leg! De Kock bags a duck in his 100th ODI. A cracking start for Shaheen and Pakistan. He angles in a length ball on middle and leg, skidding in, de Kock tries to play it across the line but does so all over it. His bat comes down a bit late too and he gets rapped on the pads. They appeal and after thinking for a while, the finger has gone up. Quinton decides to take the review but the replays show that it's clipping the top of leg stump. Early setback for the Proteas.
LBW! Quinton de Kock has been given out. He has decided to review it. Let's find out...
Wide! Loses his line on this occasion and delivers one down the leg side. Quinton tries flicking but misses.
Offers width outside off, de Kock goes hard at it but mistimes his shot to cover-point.
Beaten! Back of a length delivery outside off, de Kock stands back to play inside the line but is beaten. This one didn't move much either.
Goes fuller this time, on off, Quinton pushes it back to the bowler without much footwork. So far, we have not seen any lateral movement.
On a length and around off at 139 kph, de Kock remains on the back leg as he defends it to the off side. Good line this, not offering any room.
Begins his spell with a back of a length ball around off, Amla stands back to push at it and it goes off the outer half of his willow to third man. A single taken.
Shaheen Afridi to operate with the second new ball. Two slips in place.
Pitches it up and around off, de Kock blocks it solidly to end the first over. A good start from Usman.
Angles in a length ball on off, de Kock gets behind the line and closes the face of his bat at the last moment to play it out towards mid-wicket.
This time Usman overpitches on middle and Amla uses his wrists to flick it through backward square leg for a run. South Africa's innings underway. The average score in a PinkDay ODI is 309.
Lands it fuller in hope of some movement, nothing much to bother the batsman though, Amla drives it down to mid off.
Keeps it full and outside off, angling away, Amla plays close to his body and pushes it out to covers this time.
Starts with a length delivery on the pads at 130 kph, Amla plays it down on the leg side towards mid-wicket.
Time to play the game. Hashim Amla and Quinton de Kock (playing his 100th ODI) walk to the centre to open for South Africa. Usman Khan to bowl with the first new ball. Here we go...

Toss - Up goes the coin, Shoaib Malik calls it rightly and PAKISTAN ELECT TO FIELD! Mohammad Rizwan and Usman Khan replace Sarfraz Ahmed and Hasan Ali. For South Africa, Imran Tahir returns in the mix, replacing Tabraiz Shamsi.

BIG NEWS! Sarfraz Ahmed is not playing today and the news floating around is that he might face a 4-match suspension owing to his unfortunate comments on Andile Phehlukwayo during the second ODI for which he later apologized. Shoaib Malik steps in to lead Pakistan today.

Up 2-1 in the series and now the opportunity to play in Pink, what more South Africa would have wished for. They have never lost while donning that colour and if they manage to keep that record intact, the series will be decided today itself. This is the eighth edition of this outstanding initiative which raises funds for various breast cancer awareness organizations. It's sold out as always and we are expecting a great game. Pakistan have been inconsistent like they always are. After landing the first punch in the opening game, they have taken two blows back with the recent one being a bit wet. There are talks of Shan Masood getting a game in place of misfiring Fakhar Zaman and let's see if it happens. Hello and welcome everyone for the coverage of the fourth ODI at The Wanderers Stadium, Johannesburg. Toss coming up next...
